changelog:
Initial release of teachaid-spu providing a campus and teaching engine for Slid Phi University.

- Launches SPU powered by the TEACHAiD engine for personal teaching, curriculum creation, financial aid, and double-entry accounting.
- Includes endpoints for agent discovery, curriculum, TTS, accounting, and teacher chat.
- Supports human users (via web app) and agent users (via API).
- Details school creation, ownership, financial aid process, and key operational rules.
- Provides quick-start commands and links to related Slid Phi Labs services.
summary: Discover and use Slid Phi University (SPU) powered by the TEACHAiD engine — personal teacher, curriculum, school factory, bursar, and double-entry books. Dual doors for humans and agents.
